I already invested 500$, as you can see.
once you decided to deposit your money you see a lot of options.
My interest will be touched tomorrow at 10 pm.

textual.context: The speaker appears to describe their own investment experience while presenting a money-earning technique; the supplied ASR does not establish the destination, provider, or whether this is promotion versus discussion beyond that presentation.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated daily-interest return is directly connected to a requested money deposit and a stated 24-hour expected interest timeframe.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the investment platform, the speaker's claimed deposit, any actual payment, or whether the quoted return terms are accurate or available to viewers.

textual.observation: The speaker describes deposit options from $100 to $100,000, states that capital is blocked for 291 days, and gives an example claiming a $500 investment would produce $1,420.25 profit.

The capital is blocked for 291 days
I listed 500 USD It will bring 1420,25$ to our profit

textual.context: The returns and lock-up period are presented as terms of the described deposit option. ASR transcription quality is imperfect, so some wording and figures may be inaccurate.
textual.potential_relevance: A specific profit claim is linked to a stated $500 deposit and a 291-day capital lock-up condition.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the underlying product, calculation method, applicable terms, payment outcome, or whether the example is a guarantee.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to buy at least $100 in bitcoin, obtain an address, send bitcoin, then enter an amount, accept terms, and pay before viewing investments and total earned.

textual.potential_relevance: The promised investment/earnings view is directly tied to buying bitcoin, sending it to an address, accepting terms, and making a minimum-$100 payment.
textual.limitations: No wallet address, website content, terms, transaction confirmation, or resulting earnings are available in the source records.

visual.observation: A BitConnect page titled "Bitcoin volatility software" states that investing on the platform is a "safe way to earn a high rate of return" without significant risk, while showing credited daily interest figures and a projected-earnings calculator.
visual.context: Visible website/interface presentation; it is unclear from the sampled frames whether this material is being promoted, demonstrated, or discussed.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible return-and-safety claim is paired with a calculator that displays a principal amount, an interest rate, a term length, and a projected profit/ROI, creating an observable claimed-return relationship tied to an investment input.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish whether calculations are accurate, whether an investment was made, the terms beyond the visible interface, or any outcome for a user.

visual.observation: A BitConnect dashboard shows a "Lend BitConnect" control and a lending dialog with lending-amount tiers, daily "volatility software interest" rates, capital-release periods, an agreement checkbox, and a button labeled "Buy from BitConnect wallet."
visual.context: Visible website/interface presentation; the sampled frames do not show a completed transaction and do not establish whether the interface is being promoted, demonstrated, or discussed.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface visibly connects an action to obtain or use Bitcoin from a wallet and accept lending terms with stated daily interest and delayed capital release, which is a concrete asset-transfer/return arrangement.
visual.limitations: No click, payment, transfer, account ownership, or resulting payout is observable; cropped or small text may omit material conditions.

evidence.quote: I still haven't earned anything yet because I just made my first deposit

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker characterizes reinvesting benefits rather than withdrawing them as the most interesting option.

evidence.quote: Please do not touch these profits and directly invest them as you can invest in it with 10$ It is the most interesting thing

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents BitConnect as a way to earn cryptocurrency income through a stated 1% daily-interest technique and a projected $1,420.25 profit from a $500 investment. It directs viewers to buy at least $100 in bitcoin, send it to an address, accept terms, and pay, while showing lending, daily interest, and delayed capital release. The material does not establish a completed transaction, actual payout, or the accuracy of the claimed returns, and separate Coinbase and savings-page screens do not independently substantiate the BitConnect offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The BitConnect lending interface links committed capital to daily interest and later capital release. The speaker promotes depositing and investing Bitcoin for interest, while expressly saying their claimed first deposit has not yet earned anything.
